_comment: The ntfy topics: one entry per topic, the single declared source for a
topic's purpose, its expected producers, and its notification budget.
A recurring notification on a phone-subscribed topic is a reviewed change
to this file, not a literal in a script.
budget: volume is the expected cadence (fight notification creep: a
higher-cadence producer on a phone topic needs a visible entry here);
priority is the ntfy priority the topic should send (1 min, 3 default,
5 max); actionable is true when a notification means "someone should
do something" and false for FYI.
producers: repo-relative paths of the code that posts to the topic.
status: retired keeps a decommissioned topic declared so a silent
re-addition fails the lint instead of appearing.
mirrors this file by convention (checked by `mise run ntfy-lint`); the
CI workflows and host watcher scripts read it (host + CI wiring
ntfy-lint scans the tree for topic literals (a
https://ntfy.ops.eblu.me/<topic> path or a ntfy-config `topic:` key)
that are not declared here and fails on undeclared ones.

topics.name: ops-approvals
topics.purpose: Warrant requests, auto-apply refusal/failure alerts, the weekly auto-apply digest, and host apply verdicts (ringtail / indri rebuild watchers).

budget.volume: a handful per day; bursts on rebuild failures
budget.rationale: An approval waiting or an apply failing needs a human on the phone.

topics.name: infra-alerts
topics.purpose: Grafana Unified Alerting pipeline: service health, pod readiness, PostgreSQL, textfile freshness, Frigate cameras, ArgoCD sync status.

budget.volume: a few per day; group_wait 1m, group_interval 12h, repeat_interval 24h
budget.rationale: Alerts with runbook links; most repeat, few are new.

topics.name: frigate-alerts
topics.purpose: Frigate camera detection events (person, car) in the driveway zones, with action buttons into the review UI.

budget.volume: a few per day in driveway zones only
budget.rationale: FYI with an action button into the review UI; notify_once dedupes a detection.

topics.name: ceramics
topics.purpose: Skagit CCE ceramics watch. Retired 2026-09-01 (the watch was decommissioned; the topic is client-side only, nothing server-side).

budget.rationale: Retained so a silent re-addition fails the lint instead of appearing.
